label: DeepForest — tree crowns (airborne RGB)
description: DeepForest RetinaNet tree-crown detector (Weinstein et al.), a torchvision-style export with one class. Trained on 10 cm airborne RGB from NEON sites; works on drone orthophotos of woodland and orchards. Score thresholds are naturally low for crowns, so confidence 0.2-0.4 is usual.

source.name: kshitijrajsharma/fair-deepforest-tree-crowns (ONNX export of weecology/DeepForest)
source.export: torchvision RetinaNet exported without a batch dimension: input image[3,H,W] ImageNet-normalised, outputs boxes[N,4] xyxy, scores[N], labels[N] (0-based)
